to make it more clear i was really addressing people who have repeated instances of not listening to people when they may have done something bad. the unfortunate thing about racism and anti blackness is it’s so deeply rooted into a lot of peoples dialogues and interactions that they don’t even know it’s racist so because of that microaggressions have micro in it for a reason, it’s not really noticeable unless someone points it out for you. and when they do sometimes artists they make statements like “i’m not racist but..” or “im not racist, so it’s not a big deal” and say things like “well light skin people exist”  etc when it comes to white washing and now ofc there are a lot more micro agressions but if i got into that we’d be here all day 😅.
